folds: same five calendar boundaries as research_v2 and lookback_density_v1
activity_target: source has any outgoing a2q/c2a/c2q event in the next 24 hours
choice_target: same directed source-target pair reconnects in the next 24 hours, conditioned on source activity for two-stage models
expert_groups: last pair event <=4h or 4-24h, crossed with a2q/c2a/c2q
hyperparameters: reuse each fold's frozen v2 LightGBM configuration; no test-driven tuning
threshold: chosen only on each fold's calibration interval to maximize F1
disclosure: Designed after inspecting error patterns on both test sets. All results are retrospective exploratory analyses, not untouched confirmation. Future activity labels are used only as training targets inside past partitions and as post-hoc diagnostics, never as inference features.
